final_message:
The final query is saved as a single line in [final_strategy.txt](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-86f1a115e64cced2/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T105350Z/final_strategy.txt).

It searches emicizumab and its development names, with a publication-date ceiling of 2020-10-22. I kept haemophilia, human, and PK/efficacy terms out of required `AND` blocks: adding haemophilia reduced the tested results from 229 to 203, and adding PK/exposure/efficacy terms reduced them to 77. Those limits could miss healthy-volunteer bridging studies or eligible reports that use different outcome wording.

The NCBI CLI checks included MeSH lookup and inspection for emicizumab/ACE910, haemophilia A, and pharmacokinetics, plus tests of the candidate text-word blocks and sample records. The final query returned 235 records in the CLI check. The “factor VIII mimetic” phrase returned 8 records on its own, including a healthy-subject phase 1 study, so I retained it. No seed PMIDs were provided; seed validation was not possible.

This is a draft strategy and should be peer reviewed by a second information specialist under PRESS before use as the final systematic-review search.
